description: This file defines the MethodOverrideMiddleware class, which is a middleware component for the Slim Framework. It handles HTTP method overriding through headers and request body parameters, allowing HTTP methods like PUT or DELETE to be simulated via POST requests.

classes.name: MethodOverrideMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that overrides the HTTP method based on specific headers or POST body parameters to allow method tunneling.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the incoming server request, potentially overriding its method based on headers or body parameters, then passes it to the next request handler.
